description: This file contains functions and types for analyzing and repairing legacy 'toolsBySender' keys in a configuration object, including scanning for untyped keys, generating warnings, and performing automatic fixes.

methods.name: collectLegacyToolsBySenderKeyHits
methods.description: Recursively traverses a configuration object to find 'toolsBySender' keys with untyped or deprecated keys, collecting hits.

methods.name: scanLegacyToolsBySenderKeys
methods.description: Initiates scanning of the configuration object for legacy 'toolsBySender' keys.

methods.name: collectLegacyToolsBySenderWarnings
methods.description: Generates warning messages based on the collected legacy 'toolsBySender' key hits.

methods.name: maybeRepairLegacyToolsBySenderKeys
methods.description: Attempts to automatically fix legacy 'toolsBySender' keys by migrating them to typed id: entries, returning the updated config and change summaries.
